content.comment_body: Hello, I have set up one [product_name] as 'master' and another as 'client'. I am unable to establish communication between them. I want to use Flag M16 on the 'master' as a network input for the client, so that when M16 is activated on the master, the corresponding input on the client is also on. On the client side, which remote address should I use for Flag M16?

Hello, In the client module: set up a transfer and read 1 byte, store it locally at VBx, and use MB1 (M9...M16) as the remote address. To use M16 within the program, use NI with Address: Vx.7. You can also refer to examples on the [company_name] [product_name] support page at [url]. Hope this clarifies your issue.
